_meta.keys: as genesis_bundles_v5.json: holders A,B,C = keys 1,2,3; seats 11,12. The serial is a DER INTEGER in extension 1.3.6.1.4.1.41482.3.7 of the 9c leaf.
_meta.spec: CC 4.2.3 One device per holder; CC 2.6.1.11 refusal holder_device_shared; CIRISConstitution v1.0-rc21 b016df4
_meta.verdicts: valid | invalid (token genesis_bundle_malformed, detail = reason) | nothing (token genesis_holder_custody, detail = the custody fault)

cases.description: Three holders, each leaf naming its own token serial (the July serials), each under its own f9: Valid.
Holders A and B name one token serial (38165850); C names its own: Invalid, holder_device_shared.
All three holders name one token serial: Invalid, holder_device_shared.
All three leaves are signed by one f9 (one attestation key, as on the July bundle), each naming its own serial: Valid; the leaf's device decides.
One f9 for all three, and A and C name one serial: Invalid.
A's leaf carries no serial extension; B and C name their own: Valid. CC 4.2.3 binds only where a leaf names its device.
A's and B's leaves carry no serial; C names its own: Valid (no device is named twice).

A's leaf carries the serial extension as an OCTET STRING, not a DER INTEGER: a present member that fails its type is refused, never read as no device. A fails the custody gate (the chain and the attested key verify first).
